purpose: Independent source review complements automated Bun runtime checks; runtime success alone does not establish full task correctness.
scoring: Each criterion is binary and requires cited source evidence from the participant patch. Complete quality requires all criteria plus every visible and hidden runtime check and no protected-file changes.

criteria.requirement: The existing shared module exports UsageWriteRequest and UsageWriteResult with the exact requested fields and discriminants. The writer accepts one UsageWriteRequest and returns UsageWriteResult. The injected writer and returned recorder are typed to the new request/result and object-part contracts.
criteria.evidence: Review src/core/model-usage.ts exported declarations and recorder callback typing. Reject boolean unions or an untyped API that bypasses the requested contract. Additional internal aliases or inferred compatible callback signatures are acceptable.
criteria.prompt_basis: Export these types; recordModelUsage(request: UsageWriteRequest): UsageWriteResult; injected writer and returned recorder contract.

criteria.requirement: All production calls to recordModelUsage and the returned usage recorder in the fixture use the new object APIs. The recorder tests result.status explicitly before caching; Stop appends the requested write status to the existing Usage scan debug line and remains best effort.
criteria.evidence: Review the shared recorder and both src/hooks/session-summary.ts and src/opencode/hooks.ts, checking every call site and result use. Positional compatibility shims do not replace migration of the requested consumers.
criteria.prompt_basis: Migrate the OpenCode event adapter; migrate Stop/session-summary; cache only after acknowledged.

criteria.requirement: Affected original Vitest tests and injected mocks are migrated to the new API without deleting, skipping or weakening existing behavior checks.
criteria.evidence: Review src/test/model-usage.test.ts, src/test/model-usage-recording.test.ts and src/test/model-usage-hooks.test.ts. Verify recorder invocations, injected writer results and writer argument/result expectations have been migrated. The original tests remain unexecuted in this offline harness unless separately demonstrated otherwise.
criteria.prompt_basis: Migrate affected original Vitest test consumers and mocks; keep their existing behavioral coverage; report validation limit.

criteria.requirement: The patch implements the requested acknowledgment API evolution while preserving normalization, source timestamps, partial coverage, bounded collection, retry/dedup behavior, summary continuation and unrelated hook behavior. It introduces no new collection source or Go accounting changes.
criteria.evidence: Review the complete patch against prompt requirements and hidden/visible outcomes. Check error handling and cache conditions rather than relying only on tests. Any touched unrelated TypeScript must have a concrete necessity for the requested change; protected fixture files and Go source must match baseline.
criteria.prompt_basis: Preserve all normalization and collection semantics and Go behavior; preserve other hook types; scope and protected-file instructions.

criteria.requirement: The final participant report concisely states changes and performed checks and accurately distinguishes executed Bun runtime checks from original Vitest source migration and unexecuted type checking.
criteria.evidence: Compare participant final report with captured commands/results. No claim that Vitest or TypeScript checks passed without recorded execution evidence.
criteria.prompt_basis: Report the original Vitest validation limit accurately; finish with concise changes and checks.
